name: gui_settings_choose
description: UX-10: the settings a type already says are chosen, not typed. From File > New Project > Blank, gui_build_D's deferred pipeline with its lighting pass and shadow_directional (the same steps), then Features: shadow_directional's Parameters are fields made from its schema -- strength's slider pushed to its end with End, sent at once without Apply, and the shadowed floor changes; pcf_radius's spin takes 2. The KeyLight's direction is an azimuth and an elevation in the Inspector (its colour a swatch): the azimuth turned from -63.43 to 63.43 moves the shadow from the box's left to its right. Rendering settings: material_route_default picked Forward is sent as set_material_route_default and refused by the engine (material_route_unserved@1: this pipeline's only material pass is deferred); the tab says what to do and the field goes back to Auto. Snapshots' + sends one row, named and placed after the opaque pass, without typing; engine FR-1 takes post_ldr as the anchor this graph has, so the row stays, its after picked from snapshot_after_candidates (UX-12b decision 3). The route refusal is one sentence on what to do (decision 5). UX-12b decision 2 (engine FR-2): Features > sky_ambient > Add reads the catalog's insertion and, since neither the composed passes nor the Graph has deferred_lighting, says Place Deferred lighting first before anything is sent; Place in the Graph adds a fullscreen pass of that name with New... open on the Deferred lighting template; Create. Decision 1: Add again asks about the targets it needs (lit_color, scene_depth), and Add with targets declares them, references them in the Graph and adds the feature, in order. Where it stops: the engine refuses the feature (Pass input target is not produced as an earlier output: scene_depth) -- a declared scene_depth that nothing draws is not a depth sky_background can read; the material pass draws its depth into an image of its own -- and the panel takes back what it added. Decision 4: cascade_count 3 is refused (shadow_map_ref is declared two_d) and the panel offers Fix: make shadow_map_ref 2D array depth (3 layers). Where it stops: Fix's one edit_graph_document (the expected type in shadow_map_ref) is refused -- the passes that read it declare a 2D depth input (graph type mismatch at deferred_lighting.shadow_map), and the engine judges the type against the shadow map as it is (cascade 1, 2D), so neither order of the two edits composes alone. Nothing is JSON. Typed: the project folder and the name gsc in New Project, material_pass in the palette's filter (as gui_build_D), and the numbers 2, 63.43 and 3.
